# Beyond the Chatbox {.unnumbered}

Welcome to **Beyond the Chatbox: LLM Coding Agents for Research** (September 2026).

You will use a coding agent on small research tasks, check its work, and stay responsible for the result.

## What you need

- A [GitHub account](https://github.com/signup)
- Basic file and terminal skills
- The supplied fake data. Do not bring real research data.

We use OpenCode in a disposable GitHub Codespace. Antigravity, Codex, and Claude are optional comparisons.

Start with [Open the Codespace](start/codespace.qmd), then [find your way around VS Code](start/vscode.qmd) and [choose an agent](start/choose-agent.qmd).
